method_extensions.existing_method: Ryu–Wornell causal gambling, KT categorical and universal-portfolio simplex confidence sequences
method_extensions.exact_hypotheses: An adapted simplex-valued process with fixed conditional mean E[Y_t | F_{t-1}] = mu, and causal nonnegative portfolio bets summing to one. The categorical version uses one-hot observations. Dependence is permitted through this conditional-mean contract, not through arbitrary row drift.
method_extensions.locators: Section 2 equation (6); Theorem 2 and Section 3.1/Theorem 3 (KT); Section 4/Theorems 6–7 (probability-vector observations)

method_extensions.transfer_or_execution_gap: A posterior or estimated genealogy probability vector is not automatically conditionally unbiased for the true genealogy law. The paper is not a biological calibration result. Boundary support and certified numerical inversion require explicit treatment. No universal dominance over G6 coordinate Hoeffding is asserted.
method_extensions.next_action: Use only for a compiled bounded-vector observable with proved conditional mean. A vector confidence region still needs the source-image/target inversion adapter.
